title: STANDING AT THE EDGE OF THE PROMISE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: And at that time I told you everything you were to do. Then, as the Lord our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful wilderness that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea. Then I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us. See, the Lord your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the Lord, the God of your ancestors, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged." - Deut 1:18-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses recalls the journey through "that vast and dreadful wilderness" until they reached Kadesh Barnea, right at the edge of the Promised Land. There he spoke words meant to fill them with courage: "See, the Lord your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it... Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged." Everything was ready. God had given the land; all they had to do was trust Him and go forward.

This was the great moment of opportunity. God had brought them through the wilderness and set the promise right before them. The command was simple and the encouragement was strong: do not fear, do not be discouraged, simply trust and advance. God had already done the giving; their part was to believe and act.

How often God brings us to the edge of something good and speaks these same words to our hearts: "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged." Fear and discouragement are the great enemies of faith. They whisper that the obstacles are too big, that we are not able, that we should shrink back. But God's word calls us to look not at the giants but at the God who gives.

The Lord repeats "do not be afraid" throughout Scripture because He knows how prone we are to fear. And the antidote to fear is not our own confidence but trust in Him. He has gone before us; He has made a way; He has promised to be with us. Jesus tells His followers, "Do not let your hearts be troubled" (John 14:1). When you stand at the edge of what God has for you, hear His word: do not fear, do not be discouraged. Trust Him, and go forward.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What fear or discouragement is holding you back from moving forward in faith?
2. Are you looking at the obstacles or at the God who gives?
3. How does hearing God say "do not be afraid" strengthen you today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, when fear and discouragement whisper to me, help me to hear Your voice saying, "Do not be afraid." Fix my eyes on You, the God who goes before me, and give me courage to trust and advance. Amen.
